criticalIssues.issue: Indefinite Timeout on npm Test Execution
criticalIssues.description: Architecture validator hangs indefinitely when executing 'npm run test -- --testNamePattern="Pattern|Architecture" --verbose' command
criticalIssues.impact: Validator is completely unusable for routine validation tasks
evidence: Multiple test attempts all timed out at 30-60 seconds
Timeout occurs regardless of scope configuration
System shows 'Project templum may not be fully supported by architecture validator' warning

criticalIssues.description: Providing different scope patterns (custom scopes, empty scopes) does not change validation behavior or performance
criticalIssues.impact: Cannot optimize validator performance by limiting scope
evidence: Test with --scope "src/**/*.ts" still times out at same point
Test with --scope "nonexistent/**/*.xyz" still times out at same point
Validator does not use scope information to limit test execution

criticalIssues.issue: Design Flaw: Tests Not Designed for Validation
criticalIssues.description: Validator attempts to run full npm test suite which may include long-running integration tests inappropriate for validation
criticalIssues.impact: Validator cannot complete in reasonable time for CI/CD workflows
evidence: Found 10 test files in tests/ directory including e2e tests
npm test command tries to run all tests matching pattern rather than quick validation checks
No timeout controls in validator test execution

criticalIssues.description: Validator assumes tests with 'Pattern' or 'Architecture' in name exist, but may not find appropriate tests
criticalIssues.impact: May produce false positives/negatives due to test pattern mismatch
evidence: No files found with obvious 'pattern' or 'architecture' naming in test directory
Validator does not verify test pattern exists before executing
Test execution gets stuck suggesting pattern match issues

claimedBehavior: Pattern implementation verification via npm tests
Design pattern compliance via grep analysis of code structure
Dependency injection validation via npm tests
Scalability testing via curl requests to localhost:3004
actualBehavior: Gets stuck on first npm test command indefinitely
Never reaches grep analysis due to timeout
Never reaches dependency injection tests due to timeout
Never reaches scalability tests due to timeout

customScopeTest.scopeEffect: Scope parameter accepted but ignored during test execution

emptyScopeTest.scopeEffect: Empty scope pattern does not prevent test execution

errorHandlingTest.result: SUCCESS - proper error message for missing project configuration

recommendations.action: Redesign architecture validator to use lightweight checks instead of full npm test suite
recommendations.details: Replace npm test execution with targeted analysis tools that can complete in under 30 seconds

recommendations.action: Implement proper timeout controls in validator test execution
recommendations.details: Add configurable timeouts for each test phase and graceful failure handling

recommendations.action: Make scope configuration actually affect test execution
recommendations.details: Modify validator to limit analysis to files matching scope patterns rather than running project-wide tests

recommendations.action: Add pre-validation checks to verify test patterns exist before execution
recommendations.details: Check if project has appropriate tests before attempting to run them

recommendations.action: Implement fallback validation methods for projects without specific architecture tests
recommendations.details: Provide alternative validation approaches when npm tests are not available or appropriate
